snippet.title: Chivalware | AVAILABLE NOW!
snippet.description:
Chivalware, a fast-paced action roguelite where you fight on a grid battlefield, is OUT NOW on Steam and Nintendo Switch 2: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3591900/Chivalware/

Dodge relentless enemy attacks while matching tiles to charge your weapons – the more tiles you match, the more times you can attack!

Blending real-time, rapid grid-based combat and deeply satisfying tile matching in a nonstop, dance-like battle, Chivalware will send you into the deepest flowstate like you’ve ever experienced.

💾 Cleverly match tiles in a real-time, grid-based, dance-like battle
🔓 150+ upgrades, 80+ weapons, 5 playable characters to unlock as you progress through the leaderboard on your quest to topple the king
🗺️ Explore 4 zones and challenge their bosses
💪 6 challenge levels to test your skills and earn more rewards

Follow the game on socials:
X / Twitter - https://twitter.com/RegalPigeon 
Discord - https://discord.gg/Mkg9mb9z
